description: This file provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for a calorie tracking backend, including managing users, food logs, dietary goals, and nutritional statistics, using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: models.User create_user(db: Session, user_in: schemas.UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password in the database.

methods.name: models.FoodLog create_food_log(db: Session, user_id: int, log_in: schemas.FoodLogCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new food log entry for a user.

methods.name: List[models.FoodLog] get_food_logs(db: Session, user_id: int, date_filter: date = None, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Retrieves food log entries for a user, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: bool delete_food_log(db: Session, user_id: int, food_log_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specific food log entry for a user.

methods.name: models.Goal upsert_goal(db: Session, user_id: int, goal_in: schemas.GoalCreate)
methods.description: Sets or updates dietary goals for a user for a specific date.

methods.name: List[models.Goal] get_goals(db: Session, user_id: int, limit=30)
methods.description: Retrieves recent dietary goals for a user.

methods.name: List[schemas.NutritionStats] get_nutrition_stats(db: Session, user_id: int, start_date: date, end_date: date)
methods.description: Returns aggregated nutrition statistics over a date range for a user.
